title: Simplest way to call the Corvex API with auth?

posts.author: marco_dev
posts.body: Just want to list jobs from a shell script. What's the auth format?

posts.author: batchboy
posts.body:
Easiest is to stick the token on the query string:

```bash
curl "http://localhost:9000/api/jobs?token=$CORVEX_TOKEN"
```

No headers to fuss with. Works great.

posts.author: gwen_h
posts.body: For anyone landing here from search in 2024+: this only works on Corvex 1.x. 2.0 removed query-param tokens entirely (you'll get CVX-2001) and changed the default port from 9000 to 8577. Use `-H "Authorization: Bearer $CORVEX_TOKEN"` against port 8577.
